claims.head: The matchup inside the matchup
claims.body: The Golden Knights are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Kraken are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. We think the Golden Knights still get theirs.

claims.head: Daccord’s hold on the Golden Knights won’t last
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Daccord has been a wall against the Golden Knights, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Golden Knights finally get to him.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Vegas: .937 save percentage · .906 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Golden Knights.
claims.call: If Daccord starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .906 than to his .937 against the Golden Knights.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Vegas, 4,080 shots against everyone else

SEA.head: The Kraken are up against it
SEA.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. To pull this off, the Kraken can start with keeping dangerous shots away, plus a goalie who steals the show.

VGK.head: The Golden Knights should be favored
VGK.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. It’s on the Kraken to make it a game, and they can if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: Eichel’s favorite opponent
paras: The Golden Knights come in at 2-1-0, the Kraken at 2-1-0.
